title: Von Däniken's ancient-alien gods as spaceships

as_told.title: Chariots of the Gods: ancient astronauts started civilization

plain: Michael Shermer, a writer known for questioning extraordinary claims, mentions on Jesse Michels's podcast the ideas of Erich von Däniken, a Swiss author who argued that ancient peoples were visited by aliens. Shermer sums it up as the belief that the ancient gods were actually spaceships, an idea also popular on the television show Ancient Aliens, and he cites places like Easter Island as examples people point to.
